concept.title: Carers
concept.shortdesc: People who provide unpaid care or support to a relative or friend, including former and foster carers, sometimes alongside the person they care for.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
